Name: Stardew Valley Expanded Forage Crops and Bushes
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/RzDonSK.png[/img]﻿[/center][left]﻿[/left][center][/center][left]Welcome to another Forage Crops' mods, this one is for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] and its forage items. Gives you the choice to grow them on your farm instead of going out foraging if that isn't your playstyle or you don't have the time to. [/left][center][/center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/qlJfxJu.png[/img]﻿[/center][size=3][u][b][center]Brand New Crops[/center][/b][/u][/size][list]
[*][b]11 Standard Crops:[/b] Most of these will have requirements that you will have to meet before becoming available, stopping you from obtaining certain items too early. Check the guide in Articles for full details.
[*][b]1 Giant Crop[/b]
[*][b]1 Aquatic Crop[/b]: Planted right into water sources or water pots. For this crop to be available, it requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975]Machine Terrain Framework[/url].﻿
[*][b]5 Bushes[/b]: Bushes and Mushroom stumps that work just like Tea Bushes, survive all year round, don't need watering and will only produce during the right weather, conditions or season. For these crop bushes to be available, it requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]Custom Bush[/url]﻿.
[/list]
[center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2389][u][b]For full information about how to unlock, where to buy and more about each crop, check the guide in Articles[/b][/u][/url]﻿[/center][u][b]
[size=3][center]Alternative Crop Textures[/center][/size][/b][/u]Included in the mod folder, allows for different colour flower crops and a modular raised bed crop. This requires Alternative Textures to work and if you do not want this feature, then simply delete the [b][AT] SVE Forage Crops[/b] folder from the SVE Forage Crops main folder.

[size=3][u][b][u][center]SVE Crop & Item Tweaks[/center][/u][/b][/u][/size]These small tweaks do not change much, all tweaks can be enabled and disabled through configs. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is highly recommended to make this easier.
[list]
[*]Change Rafflesia into the [b]Flower [/b]category, allowing it to flavour honey. This is [i]disabled by default[/i].
[*]Allow Monster Mushroom and Green Mushrooms to be put in the Dehyrdator to make Dried Mushrooms. This is [i]disabled by default[/i].
[/list]
[size=3][u][b][center]Compatibility & [u]SVE Crop Tweaks[/u][/center][/b][/u][/size]This mod just adds crops, seeds and saplings for growing forage items so it is extremely compatible. Additionally, this mod adds not just compatibility options for items introduced by this mod, but also for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]'s crops.

Currently includes compatibility for:

[u][b]Cornucopia - More Flowers:[/b] [/u]
[list]
[*]Display name for Rafflesia Cuttings to Ferngill Rafflesia Cuttings.
[*]Texture of Rafflesia crop to match Cornucopia's compatibility patch.
[/list][b][u]Cornucopia - More Crops:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]SVE Butternut Squash and seeds display name to "Valley Butternut Squash" and "Valley Butternut Squash Seeds"
[*]SVE Cucumber and seeds display name to "Ferngill Cucumber" and "Ferngill Cucumber Seeds"
[*]SVE Pear and sapling display name to "Highland Pear" and "Highland Pear Sapling"
[*]SVE Nectarine and sapling display name to "Ferngill Nectarine" and "Ferngill Nectarine Sapling"
[*]SVE Persimmon and sapling display name to "Highland Persimmon" and "Highland Persimmon Sapling"
[*]SVE Sweet Potato and seeds display name to "Valley Sweet Potato" & "Valley Sweet Potato Seeds"
[/list]
[b][u]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]SVE Cucumber and SVE Sweet Potato can be used to make same artisan goods their Cornucopia countparts make.
[/list]Please let me know if you do find any other duplicates in others mods or other conflicts.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/PFaqirY.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center][b][u][size=3]Heavily Configurable:
[/size][/u][/b]As of all mods, I've made it as configurable as possible, so you can tweak this mod to your liking and playstyle. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is highly recommended to make all config changes easier.

[list]
[*]All crops and bushes can be disabled, any crop you do not want you can disable. Two are [i]disabled by default[/i].
[/list][list]
[*][b][u]Edible Green Mushroom:[/u][/b] Allows Green Mushrooms to be put in the Dehyrdater to make Dried Green Mushrooms by adding 'Edible_Mushroom' tag to the item. [i]Disabled by default[/i].
[*][b][u]Edible Monster Mushroom:[/u][/b] Allows Monster Mushrooms to be put in the Dehyrdater to make Dried Monster Mushrooms by adding 'Edible_Mushroom' tag to the item.[i] Disabled by default[/i].
[/list][list]
[*][b][u]Monster Mushroom Category Change:[/u][/b] Changes Monster Mushrooms Category to [b]Mushroom[/b]. This is only a display name change, Monster Mushrooms are still vegetables.
[*][b][u]Mushroom Category Changes:[/u][/b] Changes all other Mushroom items into the [b]Mushroom [/b]Category. This is only a display name change, no game play changes.
[*][u][b]Rafflesia Category Change:[/b][/u] Changes SVE's Rafflesia from the [b]Forage [/b]Category to the [b]Flower [/b]category. This changes it's function, now able to flavour honey and only effects SVE's Rafflesia, no other mod's Rafflesia. This however shouldn't change its gift tastes.[i] Disabled by default[/i].
[/list][list]
[*][b][u]Rafflesia Cornucopia Texture:[/u][/b] Select what texture you want the Rafflesia crop to match, SVE's Original look or match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flower[/url]﻿'s compat look.
[/list][list]
[*][b][u]Cornucopia Compatibility:[/u][/b] Adds the compatibility changes to SVE's crops names, uses in Cornucopia's Artisan Machines and Rafflesia's name listed in the Compatibility & SVE Crop Tweaks section above.
[/list]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/uYtcbkA.png[/img]﻿[/center]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]Custom Bush[/url] and[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975] Machine Terrain Framework[/url]. Optionally download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] as well for extra aesthetic features.
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play.
